description: Pixelate a whole JPEG, PNG or WebP, or only given rectangles (pixelate, blur or a solid box) to hide faces, plates and text. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

areas.description: Rectangles to hide, in pixels of the image as it is displayed (a phone photo's EXIF rotation is applied first), with x and y the top-left corner. Parts outside the image are ignored. Leave empty to pixelate the whole image.

height.description: Height of the area in pixels.

width.description: Width of the area in pixels.

x.description: Left edge of the area, in pixels from the left of the image.

y.description: Top edge of the area, in pixels from the top of the image.

blockSize.description: Size of each pixel block, or the blur radius, in image pixels (2–512). Bigger hides more. Omit for about a fiftieth of the image's longest side.

data.description: The image file as base64, in the format given by type.

format.description: The output format. 'auto' keeps the source's own format.

name.description: The source filename. The result keeps its stem, with -pixelated and the output format's extension.

style.description: How to hide each area: 'pixelate' (blocks of average colour), 'blur', or 'solid' (a black box). Use 'solid' for text that must not be read: small-block pixelation and blur of text can sometimes be reversed. 'solid' needs areas.

type.description: The MIME type of the source image: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp.

name: pixelate_image
title: Pixelate Image
